title: Yes Bank Private Prime credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A Private Prime variant delivering the highest tier of Yes Bank privileges, with luxury travel perks, milestone bonuses, exclusive partner offers, and personalized experiences.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: Buy One get One free on BookMyShow for movie tickets, with a maximum cap of 4 complimentary tickets per month, and enjoy a 50% discount on event tickets, with a maximum cap of ₹1,000 per month.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: Golf
benefitRows.offer: Enjoy 12 rounds of complimentary green fees per year (Up to 3 per quarter), along with 4 complimentary green fee accesses for guests (limited to 1 per quarter), and 4 complimentary golf lessons annually, with a maximum of 1 per quarter.|Additionally, relish golf privileges at esteemed international courses, including TPC and PGA venues.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Access the designated golf booking portal using the email ID registered with your credit card. Choose your preferred golf course, date, and time, and complete the booking. You’ll receive a confirmation via email, take this with you when you play. Note that additional costs like caddy fees and carts are usually not covered and must be paid at the course.
